SA No.12 of 2012
Krishan Kumar Aggarwal ........Appellant
v.
Smt. Gyan Kaur and Others ......Respondents
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Kanwaljit Singh, Advocate for the 
appellant, through video conferencing.
Mr. Sameer Rawat, Advocate holding 
brief of Mr. Nikhil Singhal, Advocate for the 
applicant in impleadment application, IA 
No.13946 of 2021.
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the 
respondents.
Heard on the Substitution Application, 
IA No.13951 of 2026.
It is the case of the appellant that the 
sole appellant has passed away on 
15.03.2026. Therefore, his legal 
representatives, i.e. appellant nos. 1/1, 
1/2, 1/3 and 1/4 may be brought on record.
It is not objected to by learned counsel 
for the respondents, as such.
The substitution application is allowed.
Let the amended memo of parties be 
filed within a week.
List this matter on 18.09.2026, along 
with the connected case.
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
07.08.2026
RV
